cells.name: Watchtower
cells.description: A perimeter lookout tower: a sandbagged platform on legs, cabin, searchlight, ladder.

cells.name: Saluting base
cells.description: The low reviewing dais at the head of the parade square.

cells.name: Flag mast
cells.description: A tall flag mast and plain pennant, with its long shadow.

cells.name: Parade line
cells.description: A painted line along the middle of its row; runs join end to end.

cells.name: Parade corner
cells.description: The painted border's corner: lines along the middle of its north row and west column, open to the south and east.

cells.name: Parade ranks
cells.description: A dashed rank line marking where a file stands; runs join end to end.

cells.name: Parade centre
cells.description: The square's painted centre mark: a cross in a ring.

cells.name: Parked tank
cells.description: A Hegemony medium tank parked in the vehicle park, turret and gun forward (west).

cells.name: Parked APC
cells.description: An army APC parked in the vehicle park, nose and turret forward (west).

cells.name: Satellite uplink dish
cells.description: A ground station dish tilted up on its pedestal, a feed horn on struts, on a railed concrete pad; for the command post's dish farm.

cells.name: Search radar tower
cells.description: A steel lattice tower carrying a long search-radar antenna bar, its long shadow to the south-east.

cells.name: Fuel bladder
cells.description: A pillow fuel bladder in a low earth bund, a hose to its pump; a fuel depot cell.

cells.name: Generator set
cells.description: A skid-mounted diesel generator in an olive housing: exhaust stack, fuel tank, cable runs.

cells.name: Antenna mast
cells.description: A tall guyed radio mast: base plate, three guy wires to anchors, its long thin shadow.

cells.name: Medical marker
cells.description: A painted panel by the medical post: a plain white cross on a green square, worn. A floor decal; blocks nothing.
